topic: Template Class Constructor with Forwarding Reference
explanation: In modern C++, templates allow for generic programming by enabling classes and functions to operate with generic types. A template class constructor can accept forwarding references (also known as universal references) to perfectly forward arguments, preserving their value category (lvalue or rvalue). This technique is essential for implementing efficient, flexible, and generic resource management or initialization patterns, especially in conjunction with move semantics and perfect forwarding. It allows the constructor to initialize class members with arguments of various types without unnecessary copying or conversions.
keywords: perfect forwarding constructor, forwarding reference constructor, universal reference C++, template perfect forwarding
